objective: Distinguish an explicitly required present-state eligibility condition from future workplace and mobility preferences, using unchanged real pointwise inputs.
labelProvenance: Manual unblinded review of the actual v2 ARS09 stage1 errors and complete current Brief/Memory, frozen before prompt-v5 replay. Separate from other frozen diagnostic datasets.
limitations: Three post-observation cases, not representative model accuracy.
Exact private source profile/Brief/Memory/Behavior inputs; no synthetic replacement facts.
No DB writes, recommendations, or external delivery.

cases.reviewNote: The current Hiring Brief explicitly requires an existing present-state eligibility condition. The supplied current profile contradicts it, and dated Brief/Memory contain no superseding evidence. Openness to future work or movement does not satisfy that present-state requirement.
